corrected_code:
@router.websocket("/ws/canvas/{canvas_id}")
async def canvas_collaborate(
    websocket: WebSocket,
    canvas_id: UUID,
    token: str = Query(...)
):
    user = await decode_jwt_token(token)
    if not user:
        await websocket.close(code=status.WS_1008_POLICY_VIOLATION)
        return

    canvas = await CanvasDocument.filter(
        id=canvas_id,
        workspace__members__user_id=user["sub"]
    ).first()
    if not canvas:
        await websocket.close(code=status.WS_1008_POLICY_VIOLATION)
        return

    await websocket.accept()
    await hub.register_peer(str(canvas_id), user["sub"], websocket)
    await hub.stream_deltas(str(canvas_id), websocket)
